question: Is direction D002 already explored or contradicted: Reposition the work as a boundary test of the residual component rather than a method for context-enriched supervision. Chain/path supervision is credited to prior art and used only as a control; the repair loop and RL stage are dropped from the primary contribution. The deliverable becomes a matched-budget, inference-context-matched training comparison that asks whether peripheral same-passage context adds anything beyond the chain and beyond token budget, reported with per-hop accuracy, a one-hop failure rate, and a transfer gap - with a pre-registered negative/boundary outcome.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
